description: This Scala source file defines the FlowAnalysis object responsible for analyzing logical plans within Spark SQL pipelines, resolving datasets, handling streaming and batch inputs, and constructing DataFrames for pipeline execution.

methods.name: createFlowFunctionFromLogicalPlan
methods.description: Creates a FlowFunction that analyzes a LogicalPlan with given inputs and configurations, returning a FlowFunctionResult.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Analyzes a LogicalPlan by inlining CTEs and resolving dataset references, returning an analyzed DataFrame.

methods.name: readBatchInput
methods.description: Resolves and reads a batch dataset by name, handling internal and external identifiers.

methods.name: readStreamInput
methods.description: Resolves and reads a streaming dataset by name, handling internal and external identifiers.

methods.name: readGraphInput
methods.description: Reads a dataset defined within the same DataflowGraph, resolving its input and handling confs.

methods.name: readExternalBatchInput
methods.description: Reads a batch dataset from an external catalog or path.

methods.name: readExternalStreamInput
methods.description: Reads a streaming dataset from an external catalog or path.
